## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. List the affected distributions.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant package CI commands and isolated artifact checks pass.
- [ ] Shared changes cover dependent packages and optional-integration profiles.
- [ ] Public behavior changes have package-specific changelog entries or fragments.
- [ ] Imports, compatibility floors and optional dependencies remain intentional.
- [ ] Recovery/ownership changes include failure and concurrency evidence.

For releases, identify the independently reviewed artifacts and checksum manifest.
Do not squash or rebase a history-preserving migration PR.
